text: What happens if I don't sleep for two days?

steps.title: Tiredness keeps building
steps.say: The longer you stay awake, the more tired signal piles onto your brain cells. Coffee only hides some of it, so by night two it covers very little.

closeup.basis: Adenosine buildup with time awake; my own simplified illustration

steps.title: Sugar control slips
steps.say: Without sleep, insulin works less well, so sugar lingers in your blood and you may feel hungrier, especially for heavy food like tonight's pizza.

lines.text: Two nights awake would leave your brain badly overloaded with tiredness, and coffee would barely cover it.
You may feel foggy, hungrier, and slower to react, with brief micro-sleeps hitting without warning.
Insulin works less well, so sugar stays higher after meals. A full night mostly resets this.
